nodes.name: keys.ts
nodes.summary: Re-exports credential and key-store types from the RPC Zod validation schema (single source of truth) and defines HTTP-specific response shapes (KeysListResponse, ValidateKeyResponse, AutoDetectResponse) used by hosted-service API key helpers.

nodes.name: keyVault.ts
nodes.summary: Defines KeyVault status types — env var extraction, marketplace listing/verification state, and the legacy flat QuotaSnapshot wire format — used by the KeyVault Accounts panel and validation wizard.

nodes.name: App.tsx
nodes.summary: Root React component that wraps the app in AppProviders and mounts AppBootstrap inside a top-level ErrorBoundary to catch synchronous throws from bootstrap hooks.

nodes.name: AppProviders.tsx
nodes.summary: Outermost React context layer providing a Jotai instrumented store and a per-window scoped state provider; mounted once above AppBootstrap.

nodes.name: McpLogoIcon.tsx
nodes.summary: Wraps the Model Context Protocol logo SVG as a forwardRef icon component matching the Lucide icon API used across toolbars.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Bundles per-database-engine SVG logos (Mongo, MySQL, Neon, Postgres, Redis, SQLite, Supabase, Turso) and exposes DatabaseIcon/DbClientIcon components that pick the right icon by DatabaseType.

nodes.name: LICENSE.md
nodes.summary: Dual MIT / Bitstream Vera license text for the bundled Hack font, included for third-party attribution compliance.

nodes.name: gemini.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the Gemini model's gradient star-shaped SVG icon, using scoped gradient IDs so multiple instances on the page don't collide.

nodes.name: scopedGradientIds.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that generates document-unique SVG gradient element IDs (via useId) so inline gradient-based icons don't share <linearGradient> refs across instances.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Formats CLI/API agent type identifiers into human-readable labels and exposes ordered lists of CLI agent types and API key provider types plus an isApiKeyProvider predicate.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared provider/agent type re-exports from the canonical keys schema plus the ORGII_ORCHESTRATOR provider constant, used by icon and agent-configuration modules.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Vertical in-page navigation component that renders a list of links scrolling to corresponding sections within a container.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders the ORGII brand mark (the 'II' glyph in a circular frame) as a theme-aware SVG, used in chrome such as the sidebar and splash screen.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Native avatar component that renders an image when a src is provided, otherwise falls back to rendering children (initials/icon) on a neutral background.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Compact avatar-plus-label chip built on Avatar, with display and selectable variants and selected/disabled visual states.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Native breadcrumb navigation supporting both an items prop and Breadcrumb.Item children, with custom separators and maxCount truncation.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Native button component implementing variant (primary/secondary/tertiary/danger/warning/success) and appearance (solid/outline/dashed/ghost) styling axes, including loading and icon states.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a two-axis variant/appearance styling model resolved via getStyleClasses rather than a class-variance-authority library.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Shared ORGII category badge (tier pill) that renders a coloured pill for a model's pool category, e.g. 'Pro' or 'Pro Max'.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting chart primitives (ChartAxisTick, ChartTooltip, MultiLineChart) and shared chart style tokens for consumers.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable layout and styling primitives for chat-style message bubbles (avatar, header, body, copy button, layout), shared by the Simulator Messages and Inbox feed.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Clickable image thumbnail for chat surfaces that resolves heterogeneous image references (data URLs, remote URLs, or local file paths read via Tauri fs) and opens a full preview overlay on click.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Native checkbox and CheckboxGroup components supporting controlled/uncontrolled modes, indeterminate state, sizes, and theme-aware styling.

nodes.name: CommentRow.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a single code review comment row with severity icon, file/line link, copy-to-clipboard action, and expandable long-message truncation.

nodes.name: FileLink.tsx
nodes.summary: Small clickable file:line link used in code review UI to jump to a specific file location via an onOpenFileAtLine callback.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-exporting the CodeReviewBlocks components (CommentRow, FileLink, SeverityIcon) and the SEVERITY_CONFIG constant.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Top-level app component that renders AppProviders wrapping an ErrorBoundary around AppBootstrap.

nodes.name: AppProviders
nodes.summary: React provider component that creates a memoized instrumented Jotai store and wraps children in WindowStateProvider.

nodes.name: GeminiIcon
nodes.summary: SVG icon component rendering the Gemini gradient star mark, using scoped gradient IDs from useScopedGradientIds.

nodes.name: useScopedGradientIds
nodes.summary: Hook that maps a list of base gradient ID names to document-unique IDs derived from React's useId, for use in inline SVG gradients.

nodes.name: formatAgentType
nodes.summary: Converts a snake_case agent type string into a Title Case display label, stripping _api/_cli suffixes.

nodes.name: formatModelAgentType
nodes.summary: Agent type label formatter for model catalog surfaces; applies label overrides (e.g. Cursor) before falling back to formatAgentType.

nodes.name: isApiKeyProvider
nodes.summary: Predicate checking whether an agent type string is a direct API key provider rather than a CLI agent.

nodes.name: Avatar
nodes.summary: Renders an avatar image when src is provided, memoizing style computation, otherwise falls back to children content.

nodes.name: getVisualClassName
nodes.summary: Computes the Tailwind class name for an AvatarChip's visual state based on variant, selected, and disabled flags.

nodes.name: BreadcrumbItemComponent
nodes.summary: Renders a single breadcrumb item, navigating via react-router when an href is provided or invoking a click callback otherwise.

nodes.name: Breadcrumb
nodes.summary: Main breadcrumb component that renders either an items array or Breadcrumb.Item children, handling truncation via maxCount and click/navigate behavior.

nodes.name: defaultAppearanceFor
nodes.summary: Returns the default visual appearance (solid/ghost) for a given button variant when no explicit appearance is passed.

nodes.name: getStyleClasses
nodes.summary: Resolves the Tailwind class string for a button's base and hover states given its variant and appearance combination.

nodes.name: CategoryBadge
nodes.summary: Renders the coloured category tier pill for a given categoryId/categoryIndex, using i18n for the label text.

nodes.name: ChatBubbleCopyButtonComponent
nodes.summary: Copy-to-clipboard button shown on chat bubble hover, copying message content and showing a localized success toast.

nodes.name: resolveImageSrc
nodes.summary: Normalizes a heterogeneous chat image reference (data URL, remote URL, or local file path) into a displayable src, reading local files via Tauri fs when needed.

nodes.name: getCheckboxIconClassName
nodes.summary: Computes the Tailwind class name for the checkbox's icon box based on checked/indeterminate/disabled/theme state.

nodes.name: Checkbox
nodes.summary: Single checkbox control supporting controlled/uncontrolled checked state, indeterminate display, group-context membership, and click/change handling.

nodes.name: CheckboxGroup
nodes.summary: Manages a group of checkboxes sharing selected values, providing group context and controlled/uncontrolled value state to child Checkbox components.

nodes.name: CommentRow
nodes.summary: Renders a code review comment with severity icon, clickable file:line link, copy action, and expand/collapse for long messages.

nodes.name: FileLink
nodes.summary: Renders a file:line reference as plain text or a clickable button that invokes onOpenFileAtLine.
